text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Teio Sho. Smart Falcon 
steadily racks up wins toward her goal of 
taking first in every single race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, in the back of her mind, she 
still felt that she hadn't reached the 
sheer fervor of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the famed seven-time 
G1-winning Student Council President, 
Symboli Rudolf, appears to commend their 
achievement in elevating the dirt racing 
scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next target is the JBC Classic. 
Spurred on by the Chairwoman's 
expectations, Smart Falcon brimmed with 
even greater motivation.
